instruction: Now you are facing towards a door. Turn slightly right. Move forward. Turn slightly right. You will see an open door. Go inside the open door. Turn  slightly left. You will see an open door in front of you. Go through the open door. Turn slightly left. You will see a small table beside the sofa. Move forward to the small table in front of you. Turn left. You will see an opening in front of you. Move forward and go through the opening. Turn slightly left. Move forward to the closed door in front of you. Turn slightly right. Move forward. Turn slightly left. Move forward. Turn slightly left. You can see an open door in front of you. Move forward and go inside the open door. Turn slightly right. Move forward by passing through the piano and stand in front of the window. You have reached your destination.
